overview: Force Resistance is a adept-level light side technique classified under Protection. Fortifies the mind and body against dark-side assaults, mental intrusion, and debilitating Force powers through disciplined inner calm. Jedi Council members trained in resistance to withstand Sith sorcery and interrogation during the Clone Wars.
history:
Force scholars trace Force Resistance across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in Clone Wars · KOTOR II · The Old Republic · Films established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Force Resistance into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for protection specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Force Resistance alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The Jedi teach that this ability must serve life, consent, and the greater good — never domination or fear.
significance:
Force Resistance exemplifies how protection abilities shape Force doctrine on the light side. At adept mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Force Resistance could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Force Resistance remains a benchmark of protection proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
notableEvents: First major documented use of Force Resistance in New Republic conflicts
Standardised in Protection curricula of the Jedi academies
Featured prominently in media: Clone Wars · KOTOR II · The Old Republic · Films
Requires Adept training minimum before field deployment
